minutes.headline: Sewer Commission let a Cross Road lot tie into the sewer line and sent the operations RFP back for rewrite.
minutes.summary: The remote meeting agreed that two houses at 57 to 63 Cross Road, within the sewer service area, may tie in on proper application. The commission asked the manager and the engineer to work with counsel to clarify the station operations RFP before a final vote. It agreed generator maintenance can go to three written quotes rather than a formal RFP. It also covered the rate increase, legal costs, irrigation meters, the I&I review, election options and prior minutes.

public_comment.topic: A Mass Ave resident at 1564 who has replaced her septic system twice in 17 years asked to be put on a future agenda to plead for a sewer connection.

votes.motion: Allow 57 to 63 Cross Road within the sewer service area to tie in on proper application and approval, consistent with the sewer regulations.

budget_items.what_was_said: The connection fee equals the betterment assessed to others on the line.
Two maintenance events were recalled as well below the formal procurement ceiling.
The approved budget line for generator maintenance and repairs is judged adequate, with capital as backup.
The rate rises ten percent effective July 1, with the minimum charge also rising.
The article amount changed with the final budget and the budget supersedes it.
Legal spending is running above the budget and members urged caution.
An invoice for infiltration analysis work was presented for processing.
The manager proposed hiring a contractor for data entry of meter IDs in FY21.

transfers.description: Capital article transfer in the sewer budget changed from the amount in the March article to a higher amount in the final budget
transfers.amount_as_heard: twenty nine thousand to thirty thousand

decisions.decision: The manager and engineer will work with counsel to produce a clearer station operations RFP, which will come back to the commission for a final vote.
Generator maintenance will be handled by obtaining three written quotes, not a formal RFP, with the budget number kept at the existing line.
The interim I&I review meeting is tentatively set for June 9.
The next meeting on May 26 will be held at 5:00, remotely.
The rate increase will be publicized by a bill insert and the website, with no newspaper ad.

what_happened.line: The commission moved to let two houses at 57 to 63 Cross Road, inside the sewer service area, tie in on application; the vote result was not audible.
The manager and engineer will work with counsel on a clearer station operations RFP, which returns to the commission for a final vote.
Generator maintenance will go to three written quotes instead of a formal RFP, with the budget kept at the existing line.
The rate increase will be publicized by a bill insert and the website, with no newspaper ad.
Members noted legal spending is running above budget and urged caution; an infiltration analysis invoice was presented for processing.

why_it_matters: A sewer connection decision and the rewritten operations contract affect who can join the sewer line and what the commission pays to run its stations.
A rate increase takes effect July 1, and residents will learn of it through a bill insert and the website, not the newspaper; legal costs above budget add pressure on the sewer budget.
watch_next: The next meeting is May 26 at 5:00, remotely, where the station operations RFP may return for a final vote.
The interim I&I review meeting is tentatively set for June 9.
